title: NSE / BSE index (spot chart, trade futures or options)
_sessions: ICT's killzones are New York times. These Indian windows are an adaptation to backtest, not ICT's rules: the 09:15-09:30 opening range is the Judas window ('avoid the opening ranges'), PM killzone starts around the London open (12:30 IST in summer, 13:30 in winter).
_lots: Exchange lot sizes as of the January 2026 revision (NIFTY 65, BANKNIFTY 30, SENSEX 20). NSE/BSE revise them twice a year: check your broker's contract note and edit point_value here.
data_note: Yahoo's index charts (^NSEI, ^NSEBANK, ^BSESN) are the spot index, unofficial and can lag. Futures trade at a premium (basis) and options move by delta, so take levels from your broker's futures or index chart before entering.
